# The workspace's test shards: one row per target selection, `shard kind target [libtest filters]`, read by
# scripts/tests/shards.py (the run, the job matrix and the coverage check) and by nothing else.
#
# A target is a test executable (kind bin, test, example or bench). A row with no filters runs it whole; positional
# filters are alternatives and `--skip X` removes, as in libtest. A target's rows together select each of its tests
# exactly once: the check in rust.yml fails, naming the test, on one that runs nowhere or twice.
# A shard named gate-* runs in release-gate.yml, once per release; every other shard runs in rust.yml at each landing.
# `rest` is never named: it runs every test executable this table does not name, then the doc tests.
#
# The wall-clock tests (they sleep on the clock, 60 to 180 s each) and the page test that needs a prepared Julia depot
# are in gate-* shards; the rest are cut so no landing shard runs over about three minutes of tests.

supervisor test supervisor
supervisor test fe_client --skip unresponsive_supervisor_expires_the_health_window
lane       test lane_bridge --skip outage::
lane       test capsule_workspaces
sotd-a     bin  sotd sidecars:: --skip repl_page_secret_never_reaches_command_line
sotd-b     bin  sotd --skip sidecars:: --skip repl_page_secret_never_reaches_command_line

gate-sleep test lane_bridge outage::
gate-sleep test window_start
gate-sleep test window_lease
gate-sleep test fe_client unresponsive_supervisor_expires_the_health_window
gate-wgl   bin  sotd repl_page_secret_never_reaches_command_line
